messages:
tina_cs: Heads up — Acme legal wants an SLA evidence package for renewal: daily uptime, p99 latency by route, customer-facing incident narratives for any breaches, and the credits calculation spreadsheet. Can eng/sales assemble? cc @marcus_sales

alex_m: Got it. Confirm timeframe? Raw logs?

tina_cs: They requested rolling last 90 days. Aggregated reports + queries are fine; raw logs only if asked. Also want a clear example of credit math applied to their committed uptime (99.9%).

sam_engineering: I'll export p99 and uptime per route from Observability and include the exact query we used (1d bins). I'll flag maintenance windows that explain spikes. Example query I'll attach:
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) AS p99, route, bin(time, 1d) FROM request_metrics WHERE env='prod' AND customer_id='acme' AND time >= now() - 90d GROUP BY route, bin(time, 1d)

marcus_sales: Legal asked for the spreadsheet with daily uptime, monthly aggregates, and the credit example. They want rounding and timezone notes included.

alex_m: I'll produce a CSV and sample calc. Typical buckets we show in playbook: uptime >=99.9% -> 0, 99.0-99.9% -> 10% monthly fee, 95.0-99.0% -> 25%, <95% -> 50%. I'll also note UTC normalization.

sam_engineering: I'll draft two short customer-ready incident narratives (redacting internal IDs) and link trace IDs. Traces archived at observability console; will include reproduce queries.

tina_cs: Legal-bot: please remind any redaction rules. We'll upload everything to s3://redwood-cs/acme/sla-evidence/ and keep a changelog. Action items: alex_m -> CSV + calc (EOD tomorrow); sam_engineering -> exports + narratives (+48h); tina_cs -> consolidate and send to legal when ready.

legal-bot: Reminder: redact PII, remove internal hostnames, and use customer-facing language in narratives. Include a contact for follow-ups.

tina_cs: Thanks — flag if anyone needs more time.
